name: Flow-field ribbons
summary: Soft strokes of light riding a flow the music stirs: thousands of particles in a free field, or long strands bound to a falling path; slow persistence turns them into ribbons or a starfield.
credit: The Fall path after vizz.fm's Light Fall (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Path: Free lets particles ride a curl-noise field and twelve vortices, one per note. Fall binds long strands to one path in 3D: a column dropping from above, bending and fanning out along a floor toward you. Whirlpools spirals them out of two whirlpools in a wall first. Colours: without a palette, pitch class on a circle of fifths, pulled toward the key. With one, the chord sits around the palette's current position, spread this far; cycling moves it.

params.label: Path
params.help: Free: particles ride the field anywhere on screen. Fall: long strands follow one path in 3D, a column that bends and fans out along a floor toward you. Whirlpools: they spiral out of two whirlpools in a wall and pour down between them onto the floor.

params.label: Rush in a build
params.help: How much quicker the flow runs through a build, until the drop.

params.label: Persistence
params.help: How much of a trail is left after one second.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.
